Measure the on time delivery of carriers delivering the loads
Measure the average time it takes for loads to travel from the point of origin to its destination

Calculate and measure the cost of delivery by the carrier

Calculate the percentage of scheduled trips or routes that are completed without cancellations or significant delays
Record the percentage of reserve or backup vehicles available in case of unexpected vehicle breakdowns

Record regular maintenance practices that ensure vehicles are operating at peak efficiency

Calculate efficiency of packing cargo to optimize cubic space in freight containers or trucks

Calculate reduction in travel time achieved through optimized routing compared to conventional route
Measure reduction in the total distance travelled by vehicles on optimized routes
Measure amount of fuel saved by using optimized routes compared to less efficient routes
Calculate reduction in transportation costs, including fuel, labour and vehicle maintenance expenses
Gather feedback from customers regarding the timeliness and accuracy of deliveries

pcs.pc_description: Conduct research to identify relevant data analytics, data warehousing and data management tools available in the market.
Evaluate tools features, capabilities, and suitability for the transportation network requirements.

Assess the strengths and weaknesses of different tools and technologies after considering technical factors such as scalability, performance, ease of use, integration capabilities, and compatibility with existing systems.

Prepare a report with SWOT analysis of each of the shortlisted tools. Present the report to stakeholders and conduct meeting to finalize the tool after considering the organization's budget, long-term data requirements, and the skillset of the data team.
Evaluate ETL tools that facilitate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes to ensure that data is prepared and made available for analysis.
Evaluate statistical analysis software that can be used to perform advanced analytics and predictive modelling on transportation data.
Investigate business intelligence tools that enable ad-hoc querying, reporting, and data exploration for better decision-making.
Ensure that the selected tools comply with data security and governance requirements, especially when dealing with sensitive or confidential data.
Evaluate how well the chosen tools can integrate with the organization's existing IT infrastructure and data management systems.
Conduct testing and proof of concept projects to validate the effectiveness and compatibility of the selected tools in the transportation network.
Coordinate training sessions for the data team to ensure they can effectively use the chosen tools for their data analysis tasks.
Ensure effective transition of tools to the vendor and responsible stakeholders.

pcs.pc_description: Gather historical transportation data, various mode of transportation, and any other relevant data sources from the transportation management system, or enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.

Clean the data to remove any inconsistencies, errors, or missing values. Pre-process the data to make it suitable for analysis, such as aggregating it into relevant time periods (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly).
Analyse past demand patterns to identify any seasonal trends, cyclic patterns, or significant events that might have affected demand for transportation to form the basis of Forecasting model.

Select appropriate forecasting methods based on the demand analysis and the characteristics of your data. Common methods include time series forecasting techniques like moving averages, exponential smoothing.

Use the selected forecasting method(s) to generate future demand forecasts for each product or product category in the warehouse. These forecasts will serve as estimates of the transportation needs in the upcoming periods.

Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to gather insights into upcoming promotions, new product launches, or any other factors that could impact future demand and thus impacting freight volume projections. Incorporate these insights into forecasting model.
Analyse the lead time for each mode of transportation and its related cost to understand the lead time it takes. Incorporate this lead time information into transportation mode calculations.
Gather relevant data from various sources such as transportation management systems, shipment records, customer orders, and other related databases.
Gather historical transportation data, transportation mode level information, seasonal factors, and any other relevant data.
Cleanse and pre-process the collected data to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Cleanse and identify missing values, removing outliers, standardizing units, and transforming data into a suitable format for analysis.
Identify seasonal demand patterns and trends to understand how demand varies throughout the year.
Analyse inventory levels and turnover rates to optimize stock levels and reduce carrying costs while ensuring product availability to meet demand.
Monitor demand patterns continuously and forecast accuracy to assess the effectiveness of the implemented strategies and models.
Collaborate with other teams, such as supply chain management, sales, marketing, and finance, to align demand forecasts with business strategies and plans.

pcs.pc_description: Implement data validation rules to check the integrity of incoming data.
Implement validation checks for data types, ranges, and constraints to ensure that only valid and correctly formatted data is entered into the TM.
Standardize and transform data to ensure uniformity across different sources.
Convert data into a common format, consistent units of measurement, and handling data from various systems or file types.
Maintain comprehensive documentation about data sources, data definitions, and any transformations applied.
Establish data governance after collaborating with several teams including IT teams and other stakeholders ensuring defined responsibilities and accountability.
Ensure data security and compliance with relevant data protection regulations. Implement measures to protect sensitive data and restrict access to authorized personnel only.
Optimize data storage and retrieval processes to enhance the overall performance of the transportation system, ensuring that queries and reports run efficiently.
Conduct periodic data audits to assess the overall data quality and identify areas for improvement.
Profile the data in the TM to understand its structure, content, and quality.
Assess data types, distributions, and identifying any potential data quality issues.
Clean and pre-process the data regularly to handle missing values including deduplication, and error correction.
Generate data quality reports and dashboards to communicate data quality metrics and issues to stakeholders and management.
Provide training and support to data users to promote data quality awareness and best practices for data entry and maintenance.
